19470.overview:
Enter the land of TowerFall with your friends and engage in the noble and brutal tradition of bow-and-arrow combat. Supports XBox 360 and PlayStation 3 controllers!

TowerFall is an archery combat platformer for up to 4 players. It's a local party game centering around hilarious, intense versus matches. The core mechanics are simple and accessible, but combat is fast and fierce. The focus is on player mastery and friendly rivalry.
